keyword: iowa hawkeyes men's basketball vs illinois fighting illini men's basketball timeline
claims: In the 2026 NCAA Tournament Elite Eight, the #3 seed Illinois Fighting Illini defeated the #9 seed Iowa Hawkeyes 71-59 on March 28, 2026, in Houston.
Illinois advanced to their first Final Four since 2005.
On Jan. 11, 2026, Illinois beat Iowa 75-69 in their only regular-season meeting at Carver-Hawkeye Arena, led by 19 points from Keaton Wagler, according to KCCI.
On March 26, 2026, Iowa advanced to the Elite Eight, according to this YouTube video.
On March 26, 2026, in the Sweet 16, Illinois defeated #2 seed Houston 65-55 to advance to the Elite Eight, as noted on the University of Illinois Athletics website.
Illinois leads the all-time series against Iowa 96-77.
The 2026 Elite Eight meeting was the first-ever matchup between Illinois and Iowa in the NCAA Tournament.
Illinois has won 10 of the last 11 games in the series against Iowa
